notes:
Account summary:
- Mid-market B2B SaaS (customer experience platform). Evaluating Redwood to replace expensive internal GPU infra and reduce latency for multitenant chat & search features.
- Initial PoC on Hosted API (Jan-Feb): basic chat + embeddings integration done; devs happy with SDK and streaming. Observed 70–120ms per-token on sample workloads (good).
- Demo (2026-02-18): showed multi-model routing (low-cost reranker + higher-quality chat), candidate for cost savings. Product mentioned "need predictable p95 under 400ms for chat".
- Current focus: move to Dedicated (VPC) for isolation and predictable throughput. Security team requires SOC2 evidence, SAML SSO integration, audit logs with 90-day retention & retention controls, KMS integration for key wrapping, and option for EU data residency for select customers.
- Pricing convo (AE call 2026-03-02): discussed reserved capacity vs burst; customer prefers a 12-month reserved plan but wants a 60%+ unit-cost reduction compared to current public-cloud self-host. Looking for clear break-even calculators.
- PoC plan: 4-week Dedicated eval in staging VPC. Tasks: infra sizing (Derek), SAML metadata exchange (customer IT), SOC2 artefact upload (security), perf runbook and SLOs (Redwood SRE).
- Quote request: try to keep ARR projection in 50k-150k band; procurement flagged as mid-Q2.
- Security notes: customer requires per-route audit logs (token-level cost breakdown desirable), immutable event logs for 6 months for compliance, and ability to set retention per workspace. They asked: "can we get a daily export to our SIEM (Splunk) and a hashed PII policy?"
- SE feedback: model quantization suggestions (Optimize) could reduce costs; Derek to provide config example and expected token-cost delta.
- Quote from CTO on call: "We need a clear migration path from hosted to dedicated without breaking SLAs for current customers."
- Internal: escalate SOC2 evidence upload to SEC-1294; security call scheduled 2026-03-12 (FF id above).
- Remarks: tone pragmatic; procurement timeline depends on SOC2 evidence & SAML test. Customer is price-sensitive but values reliability & clear runbooks.
